messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Error in sumstats
parts:
Hi Rama, 

I'm fairly certain the error is arising because you put T and F in quotes, which R interprets as a character instead of a logical class. If you remove the quotes, as in the se.logit code below but for all of the arguments, it should work: 

se.logit=rep(c(F), 3)

Best, 
 Andrew
